current_text.html: The Administrative Committee of General Assembly has the responsibility of nominating to the General Assembly the person to fill the office of the Stated Clerk. Additional nominations may be made from the floor of the Assembly through the regular process for additional nominations.

relationships.title: Floor nominations for Stated Clerk when AC brings no nominee
relationships.disposition: Yes — floor nominations are allowed; RAO 3-4 second sentence provides GA right to select Stated Clerk regardless of AC nominee; Adopted 8-0-0

occurrences.excerpt: The CCB ruled that floor nominations are permitted under RAO 3-4 even if the Administrative Committee does not bring a Stated Clerk nominee.

relationships.title: Floor nomination procedure for the office of Stated Clerk
relationships.disposition: floor nominations follow identical procedure to other contested offices; nominees must be examined by TEC; Adopted by the CCB

occurrences.excerpt: CCB advised that floor nominations for Stated Clerk follow the same procedure as other contested offices, and nominees must be examined by the Theological Examining Committee.
